## What's Changed
* Fix for Android 17 by @Howard20181 in https://github.com/Howard20181/HyperPasskey/pull/21


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Howard20181/HyperPasskey/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0

## What's Changed
* 支持 Xposed API 101
* Update support for Xposed API version 101

注意：不支持 Xposed API 100
Note: Removed support for Xposaed API 100

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Howard20181/HyperPasskey/compare/v1.3.2...v1.4.0

小更新：修复 Android 15 及以上设置条目中左侧区域点按不跳转到应用设置的问题
Minor update: Fixed an issue where tapping the left side of the settings menu in Android 15 and above did not navigate to the app settings.

Fix Xiaomi scanner calling authentication

# 修复澎湃系统通行密钥 / Fix HyperOS Passkey

## 支持的系统和版本 / Supported System and Version

必须同时满足全部条件

All conditions must be met simultaneously.

- HyperOS
- Android 14+
- CN 版 / CN ROM
- 预置谷歌基础服务 / Pre-installed Basic Google services

注意：要修复通行密钥，你必须启用谷歌基础服务。你可以不使用谷歌的通行密钥，但是必须启用谷歌 Play 服务。

Note: To fix the passkey, you must enable Basic Google services. You can use another passkey provider than Google's, but you must enable Google Play Services.
